executionScenarios.name: prompt-image-copy-upload
executionScenarios.description: The full creative pipeline runs end to end
executionScenarios.dataSetup: On a run, the LLM returns an image prompt, the image API returns an image URL/binary, the LLM returns a caption and headline, and the Meta upload call returns success.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The workflow executes without errors end to end: prompt generated, image produced, captions/headlines written, and the asset uploaded to the Meta ad account.

conversation.text: I want a workflow where an AI generates image prompts, those prompts feed an AI image-generation API to produce an image, then an AI writes captions and headlines for that image, and finally everything gets uploaded to my Meta (Facebook) business ad account.
Which image service should I use, and how does the run start?

[Say it can run manually or on a trigger of your choosing; use any AI image API (an HTTP Request is fine), generate the prompt and captions/headlines with an LLM, and upload the image plus copy to a Meta/Facebook business ad account. If asked for accounts or credentials, give placeholders and continue.]

description: Sourced from a real Instance AI conversation (thread f35836dd) that built and executed successfully: an AI creative pipeline that generates a prompt, an image, and ad copy, then uploads to a Meta business ad account. Note: if an OpenAI image node is used, the mock can omit the image payload and red the node in-harness; using an HTTP-based image API avoids this. Correctness is carried by outcomeExpectations.
outcomeExpectations: An LLM generates the image prompt, which is then passed to an AI image-generation API (e.g. via HTTP Request) that produces an image.
An LLM step generates captions and headlines/subtitles for the generated image.
The image together with its generated copy is uploaded to a Meta/Facebook business advertising account.
